claims.title: Uniform small coefficients and nonempty exact degree boxes
claims.statement: The actual SizesAt and logarithmic bounds give the two x^-12 coefficient estimates and width>=1 in both integer degree windows, uniformly in the family index.

claims.title: The actual MeanKappaBound at every candidate good orbit
claims.statement: Small primes have a pointwise deficit <=Nv*x^-12; large primes have the same local mean bound from the canonical Type-I deficit. Nonnegativity holds for all degrees.

claims.title: Exact global marginal averages and the total orbit deficit
claims.statement: Constant-size restriction fibres identify each local average with one common global product average; disjoint orbit fibres give E Sigma_p<=m_ch*|TT|*x^-12 without independence across primes.

claims.title: A uniform weighted exceptional-prime budget
claims.statement: The elementary harmonic bound t(1+t) and pointwise indicator bound yield E Z<=8*x^(-9-gamma), gamma=1/2-(1453/150)eps>2447/7800.

claims.title: One global degree pair satisfies exact WReq
claims.statement: For 32*x^-gamma<=1 finite averaging selects one pair with Z<=x^-9/4 and exact WReq coefficients 2 and 4, proving MeanEx and WeightVectorExists.

claims.title: ChosenW transport and realization under the separate CoverAll property
claims.statement: The actual family equalities and exact bTop window identify candidates and every Sigma term, proving ChosenW for the selected pair; CoverAll additionally gives a carrier and ChosenWS. Coverage is not inferred from averaging.

scope_note: Exact local/global finite means and ChosenW are proved for supplied family data. A carrier additionally needs the separately defined CoverAll property; no full arithmetic family, RH/GRH proof or kernel replay is asserted.
